barge.statusNote: Closed for a break until 4 Nov 2026

menssa.summary: Christophe Hardiquest's counter restaurant on Avenue de Tervueren, built around a sculpted wooden tree, where the cooks work in front of you and every dish tells a sourcing story; one star, G&M 17/20. Closing for good: the last service is on 14 Nov 2026.

daily-3000.summary: Chef Sidney Lauwers runs a six-month plant-based bakery-deli in the former Grammes premises: daily sourdough, focaccia, sandwiches, cookies and vegetarian deli dishes. A temporary concept, running until December 2026.
